sloka: सुपत्रमनुवृत्ताङ्गं सुपर्वाणं सुसंस्थितम्।सुवर्णविकृतं वीरः शरीरान्तकरं शरम् ।। ६.९१.६६ ।।
transliteration: supatramanuvṛttāṅgaṁ suparvāṇaṁ susaṁsthitam।suvarṇavikṛtaṁ vīraḥ śarīrāntakaraṁ śaram ।। 6.91.66 ।।

translations.english: And thereafter, Raghava's brother fitted another excellent arrow which had the impact of the touch of fire capable of tearing Indrajith.
